en: Illustrated postcard showing a busy harbor with several large warships and smaller boats at anchor, labeled as the port of Port Said. On the left side there is an inset vignette of a scene with a turbaned man speaking to a seated group, likely in a classroom or religious setting. Decorative flowers frame the composition. The overall style is colored lithography, typical of early 20th‑century tourist postcards.
